name: Parallel
description: Gives AI agents web search, URL extraction, and deep research APIs that return cited, structured results, with Python and TypeScript SDKs, a CLI, and hosted MCP servers.

skills.name: Search API
skills.description: Runs natural-language web searches and returns ranked results with LLM-optimized excerpts sized for agent context windows.

skills.name: Extract API
skills.description: Converts public URLs into clean markdown, with objective-focused excerpts or full page content for downstream use.

skills.name: Task Deep Research
skills.description: Runs deep research and enrichment tasks with custom output schemas, citations, SSE progress events, and webhooks.

skills.name: Web Monitoring
skills.description: Tracks web changes on a schedule with the Monitor API and sends webhook notifications when new events are detected.
